comments.author: zugi
comments.story: Cops Are Suing a Teen for Invasion of Privacy After False Arrest Vid Goes Viral
comments.why: Example of turning raid footage into music for funds
comments.text: The teen should make a music video of the footage to help raise funds for their legal defense, as Afroman did with hits like Lemon Pound Cake ( [LINK] ) and Will You Help Me Repair My Door ( [VIDEO] ). The right to record the police in public is well established now, and the claims the police are making (that technically Nathan Winter of the Newton Police Department is not a "convicted" domestic abuser, he's just an "accused" domestic abuser with a judge issuing a protective order against him) seem more likely to defame them than a brief caption in the teen's posted arrest video.
